reading.title: Waiting for a finished load
reading.text: Maya first needs to sort the laundry and load the machine. Omar checks instructions before deciding to stain treat or pre soak an item; natural sentences say treat the stain and pre-soak the item. They watch the drum spin, then wait for the cycle to finish before they unload it. Maya uses a cart to reach the folding table, where she can fold dry towels. Omar plans to hang a suitable shirt and use an iron later. He sits on the bench and asks about the change machine rather than buying something from the vending machine.

usage.goal: Identify a laundry item, stated instruction or practical distinction in an adult laundry visit.
usage.canDoStatement: Can follow a supported laundry account and ask about an item or care instruction. Specialist terms extend the supported task level; the lesson is not a product-use manual.

Care instructions and product suitability come from the written account and must not be inferred from a photograph.

reading.title: A reminder to return
reading.text: Maya sets a timer so she knows when to return to the machine. Omar brings a basket for the clean clothes. When the cycle ends, they check the drum for small items. Maya puts her clothes in the basket and folds them at the table. Omar checks the timer again before starting another load. They use the reminder to manage their waiting time and the basket to carry their laundry.
